plugins.name: agent-names
plugins.description: Gives each Claude Code session a human first name, so parallel sessions become people you can talk with and about. The name is the address ListAgents shows and SendMessage delivers to, it stays with a project across restarts, and it never overwrites your conversation title.

plugins.name: claude-boss
plugins.description: One Claude Code session coordinates the others. It dispatches work to worker sessions, keeps its tracker on disk, escalates a blocker on a timer, and asks you exactly one question when it needs you. Six hooks keep it honest: nudged when a worker goes idle, pushed to ask rather than go quiet when something is blocked, reminded when it starts implementing instead of delegating.
